The logo: one block on the cards’ line

Holger, 27 Sep: the same-line tries were not it. It should be like 1a, where the top and the bottom line start at the same place, and the two lines together should be as tall as the cards, or as the second card. So: 1a’s two lines as one flush-left block, turned as one on 12a.3’s falling line, and as tall as a card, eight ways: three heights, centred or hung off the card’s corner, three angles, and the bowl. The keepers stay as they are. Every row has a number and a name (say “F2”). Each row: the logo at 64px, then the site’s bar at a desktop width with the logo 32px tall, and a phone with it 24px tall.

F One block on the cards’ line

1a’s two lines, both starting at the same place, turned as one block on the falling line of 12a.3, and the block as tall as a card: the front card (89 of the fan’s 100), the card behind it (74) or the cards top to bottom (99). Nothing else changes: GLCA SemiBold over Medium, 1a’s gap between the lines, and the fan as it is.

F1

A card tall

The block as tall as the front card, at four degrees, centred on the fan

World of over Card Games, both starting at the same place as in 1a, turned four degrees as one block (12a.3’s line) and as tall as the front card. The block sits centred on the fan, as the keepers do.

On the bar: 144 px wide (today 170), the fan 27 px tall, the big line’s capitals 13 px tall, the small line’s 7 px, the block 24 px. On a phone: 108 px wide. File: logo-lab-out/f1-card.svg
F2

The second card’s height

The same block as tall as the card behind the front one

Off the card’s corner
